identity.name: G-Shock GA-2100
identity.one_liner: A thin, thirteen-sided resin G-Shock whose octagonal bezel drew Royal Oak comparisons and sold out worldwide within weeks of its 2019 release.

provenance_events.description: Casio released the GA-2100 in Japan in August 2019 with little advance promotion; demand outran supply almost immediately and the GA-2100-1A1 sold out worldwide, a reaction that surprised both fans and Casio.

narrative.story: The GA-2100 paired a thin, faceted resin case with an analog-digital display when Casio released it in Japan in August 2019, and demand outran supply almost immediately — a reaction neither retailers nor Casio had anticipated. Its octagonal bezel drew comparisons to the Audemars Piguet Royal Oak, and the nickname 'CasiOak' stuck across watch forums and mainstream coverage alike.
narrative.collector_notes: The original all-black GA-2100-1A1 is the reference collectors mean by 'CasiOak' by default; later colorways and metal-bezel variants (GA-2100-1A2, GA-2100-1A4, 'CasiOak Lite') expanded the line without carrying the same resale attention.
